name: Marcos Javier Alvarez
headline: Senior Full-Stack Engineer · AI/LLM Systems in Production
summary: Senior full-stack engineer specialized in taking AI from demo to production. For the past several years I have built LLM pipelines for document data extraction, communication infrastructure that syncs and classifies email and SMS at scale, and agentic workflows that are tested, cost-traced, and measured like any other engineering system. What I care about most is the gap between an AI demo and an AI system: evaluation harnesses, human-graded ground truth, cost discipline, and observability. Full-stack since 2013 — event-driven backends, React frontends, infrastructure, and DevOps.
